maddeler.e: دَرَجَة الصُّغَر الْمُطْلَق • (daraja(t) aṣ-ṣuḡar al-muṭlaq) f
maddeler.t: By surface analysis, دَرَجَة (daraja, “degree”) + أَصْغَر (ʔaṣḡar, “smallest, lowest”) + مُطْلَق (muṭlaq, “unconditional, absolute”), literally “[the] absolute lowest degree”.
s: By surface analysis, دَرَجَة (daraja, “degree”) + أَصْغَر (ʔaṣḡar, “smallest, lowest”) + مُطْلَق (muṭlaq, “unconditional, absolute”), literally “[the] absolute lowest degree”
